definitions.explanation: A small pouch or wallet specifically for carrying coins. Separate from a regular wallet in Japanese culture, where coins are commonly used for daily transactions.

examples.japanese: {小銭入|こぜにい}れ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れた→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧。
⟦{革|かわ}→革：19310_kawa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{小銭入|こぜにい}れ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦プレゼント→プレゼント：01791_purezento⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I received a leather coin purse as a gift.

examples.japanese: {小銭入|こぜにい}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{重|おも}く→重い：00804_omoi⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧きた⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦コンビニ→コンビニ：01081_konbini⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{使|つか}おう→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: My coin purse has gotten heavy, so I'll use the coins at the convenience store.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{小銭|こぜに}→小銭：02759_kozeni⟧ (small change, coins) + ⟦{入|い}れ→入れる：01098_ireru⟧ (container, holder). In Japan, many people carry a separate coin purse in addition to their ⟦{財布|さいふ}→財布：00663_saifu⟧ (wallet), since coins up to 500 yen are commonly used in everyday transactions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{革|かわ}→革：19310_kawa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{小銭入|こぜにい}れ: leather coin purse
- ⟦がま{口|ぐち}→がま口：27565_gamaguchi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{小銭入|こぜにい}れ: snap-clasp coin purse
- {小銭入|こぜにい}れ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to put in a coin purse

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{財布|さいふ}→財布：00663_saifu⟧: wallet — the general-purpose wallet, may also hold coins
- ⟦{札入|さつい}れ→札入れ：22582_satsuire⟧: billfold — a wallet specifically for bills
- ⟦{小銭|こぜに}→小銭：02759_kozeni⟧: small change, coins
